title: What If The Sun Went Out? Hour By Hour

scenes.narration: Eight minutes. That's how long you'd have before you even knew the sun was gone.
scenes.image_prompt: POV in a sunny city street, people walking normally, a countdown overlay reading 8:00, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: Then, darkness. Total. The stars come out at noon, and everyone looks up at once.
scenes.image_prompt: POV of a crowd in a city street looking up at a starry sky in the middle of the day, phones glowing, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: Hour one. The moon vanishes too. It was only ever glowing with the sun's light.
scenes.image_prompt: POV looking at a dark sky where the moon is fading to nothing, eerie silence, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: Day one. The temperature drops below freezing. Every power grid on Earth is overloaded.
scenes.image_prompt: POV of a frost-covered city with flickering power lines, breath visible in cold air, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: Week one. Minus seventy. The oceans start to freeze from the top down.
scenes.image_prompt: POV standing on a beach as waves freeze mid-motion into ice under starlight, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: But deep underground, near the Earth's core, it's still warm. And that's where you'd have to go.
scenes.image_prompt: POV descending into a glowing geothermal cave city, survivors with lanterns, warm orange light, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: How long do you think you'd survive? Day one, week one, or year one?
scenes.image_prompt: POV looking back up a mine shaft at a frozen, star-filled surface world, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16
